description: This Java source file defines the ContentServices class, which provides various static methods for managing content, content associations, content traversal, permission checks, rendering, and utility functions within the Apache OFBiz Content Management framework.

classes.name: ContentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for content management and related utility functions in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: findRelatedContent
methods.description: Finds related content based on association types and permissions, returning a list of permitted associated content items.

methods.name: findContentParents
methods.description: Traverses a content tree to find parent content items, returning a list of parent content IDs.

methods.name: traverseContent
methods.description: Traverses the content hierarchy starting from a specified content ID, returning node and pick list data.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssocMethod
methods.description: Deactivates a content association, handling permission checks and entity updates.

methods.name: deactivateAssocs
methods.description: Deactivates active associations for a given content according to specified parameters.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Renders subcontent associated with a template and map key as plain text.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Renders content associated with a template and map key as plain text.

methods.name: linkContentToPubPt
methods.description: Creates or deactivates links between content items, updating permissions and statuses.

methods.name: publishContent
methods.description: Marks a content item as published by updating its status.

methods.name: getPrefixedMembers
methods.description: Extracts entries from a map whose keys start with a specified prefix.

methods.name: splitString
methods.description: Splits an input string into a list based on a specified delimiter.

methods.name: joinString
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string with a specified delimiter.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: Encodes a map of parameters into a URL-encoded query string.
